scope.subject: Shared IDs, deterministic clock, actor metadata, optimistic locking and RFC 9457 problem boundary
scope.stage: implementation ready; Java 21 proof and protected merge pending
scope.mutation_class: G2 shared API/state foundation; no production identity or database execution

risk.rationale: The patch defines shared values used by API, authorization and audit consumers. It does not yet authenticate users, grant roles, write production data or change deployment identity. Shared-state and error-boundary compatibility require independent tests and review.
hard_overrides: SAFE-010 Self-approval: the agent cannot approve or merge its own shared foundation.
SAFE-005 Production and Identity: no production/auth-provider/database action is included; any such expansion raises the tier.
SAFE-007 Untrusted Supply Chain: no new model, MCP, remote script or unreviewed dependency is introduced.
unknowns: Java 21/Gradle compilation, Checkstyle and SpotBugs are not available locally and require exact-head CI proof.
Spring MVC exception-handler wiring and OIDC claim mapping are deliberately future tasks; T014 does not prove those runtime paths.

controls.note: Implementation, proof, code review, merge and checkbox are separate graph nodes and gates.
The patch is limited to shared Java source/tests and T014 evidence; T015+ and production wiring are excluded.
Request IDs, actor subjects and problem fields are bounded and reject control characters; no credentials are accepted by the value objects.
The problem mapper and exact version parser are implemented, but Java 21 unit/quality proof is pending.
The coding-agent edit allowlist is explicit and does not include production or identity-provider actions.
Protected merge, task checkbox and any later identity action remain human gates.

authority.implementation: BOUNDED to T014 shared source, tests and evidence
authority.merge: REQUIRES explicit code review, passing CI/Security and current-head main read-back

required_before_merge: code review with no blocking finding

next_action: Publish the exact T014 branch and obtain independent Java 21/Gradle CI and Security proof; do not mark T014 checked yet.
